purpose: one deterministic canonical security key for the frozen 503-security Massive V1 research universe, without using ticker as permanent identity
scope_restriction: canonical research key for THIS frozen universe at THIS version — NOT a universal vendor identifier

key_construction.cik_normalization: parse as SEC numeric CIK, serialise zero-padded 10-digit decimal; equivalent textual forms must not diverge
key_construction.share_class_figi_normalization: exact canonical value, or the reserved sentinel when absent
key_construction.sentinel_scope: the sentinel exists ONLY inside the key; the source field remains NULL and is never mutated
key_construction.serialization_discipline: no JSON object ordering, no Python tuple repr, no locale-dependent formatting
key_construction.ticker_role: metadata only — never part of key equality

why_no_null_in_key.problem: SQL treats NULL as not equal to itself
why_no_null_in_key.consequence: a composite join on (cik, share_class_figi) would silently drop or fragment the 29 depending on the engine
why_no_null_in_key.result: key equality is deterministic across DuckDB, Parquet, Python, hashing, GROUP BY, JOIN and partition validation

identity_basis.why: for 474 the key rests on an actual share-class identifier; for 29 it rests on the CIK being a singleton in THIS universe — a much weaker fact wearing the same shape. Flattening them would hide that.

singleton_limitation.authorised_only_because: each of the 29 CIKs is a singleton security identity inside the frozen 503-security V1 universe
singleton_limitation.does_not_establish: that CIK universally identifies share class
does_not_authorise_reuse_for: any universe containing two securities from one CIK
a later dataset where the issuer acquires another relevant listed share class
singleton_limitation.future_versions: must re-run the singleton/collision test before reuse

cik_only_key_across_503.wrong: use normalized CIK alone as the key

ticker_only_permanent_key.wrong: use frozen_current_ticker as the permanent identity
ticker_only_permanent_key.note: ticker is metadata only and never participates in key equality

raw_cik_null_sql_equality.wrong: join on (cik, share_class_figi) while both FIGIs may be NULL
raw_cik_null_sql_equality.note: no key component is NULL after normalisation, so equality never depends on SQL NULL semantics

divergent_null_replacement.wrong: replace NULL with '' in one path and the sentinel in another
divergent_null_replacement.note: they differ, which is why the sentinel is frozen in the contract rather than left to each call site

GOOG_GOOGL_collapse.wrong: collapse GOOG and GOOGL into one identity

FOX_FOXA_collapse.wrong: collapse FOX and FOXA into one identity

NWS_NWSA_collapse.wrong: collapse NWS and NWSA into one identity

second_singleton_same_cik.wrong: admit a second frozen security with the same CIK and no FIGI
second_singleton_same_cik.fails_closed: the singleton check (exactly one security per CIK) would fail, blocking the fallback rather than silently merging two securities

cik_textual_variants.note: normalisation collapses them to one key

v6_relationship.attaches: security_key_v1 to each already-frozen V6 security entity

versioning.name: security_key_v1
versioning.not_generic_security_id: the old V6 `security_id` field is NULL for all 503 and is NOT backfilled or reinterpreted as this key
versioning.if_semantics_change: create security_key_v2; never silently change the V1 hash recipe

known_limitations: the 29 singleton identities carry weaker evidence than the 474 FIGI-backed ones, and identity_basis is the only thing preserving that distinction
the fallback is scoped to this frozen universe version and must be re-tested for any future snapshot
does_not_authorize: the derived builder; after this freezes, MASSIVE_1M_DERIVED_BASE_BUILDER_SPEC_V1 must bind its identity to security_key_v1 and this artifact's digest
